mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dream_stats ( user_id, stat_date, total_dreams, happy_count, sad_count, scared_count, angry_count, peaceful_count, other_emotion_count ) SELECT #{userId}, #{statDate}, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN emotion IN ('happy', '开心', '快乐', '高兴') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN emotion IN ('sad', '难过', '悲伤', '伤心') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN emotion IN ('scary', 'scared', '恐惧', '害怕', '紧张') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN emotion IN ('angry', '愤怒', '生气') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN emotion IN ('peaceful', '平静', '安宁', '放松') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN emotion IS NULL OR emotion NOT IN ( 'happy', '开心', '快乐', '高兴', 'sad', '难过', '悲伤', '伤心', 'scary', 'scared', '恐惧', '害怕', '紧张', 'angry', '愤怒', '生气', 'peaceful', '平静', '安宁', '放松' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(created_at) = #{statDate} HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
INSERT INTO dream_place_stats (user_id, place, dream_count) SELECT user_id, place, COUNT(*) FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND place IS NOT NULL AND place != '' GROUP BY user_id, place
